summary: Final production verification on https://airyatra.co.in. Verified (1) /login page loads with Email/Phone OTP/Google login options, (2) Google login button redirects through Emergent OAuth (auth.emergentagent.com) and lands on accounts.google.com Sign in page, (3) Security headers HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection are all present on /api/* responses.

minor.issue: Some security headers are duplicated in the response (strict-transport-security, x-content-type-options, referrer-policy each appear twice) — likely set by both app middleware and Cloudflare/edge. Functionally fine but should be deduped.

critical_code_review_comments: Consider dedup of security headers between app middleware and Cloudflare/edge to avoid duplicate Strict-Transport-Security / X-Content-Type-Options / Referrer-Policy values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production URL https://airyatra.co.in verified: login page renders, Google OAuth flow reaches accounts.google.com via Emergent OAuth intermediary (https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=...), and all required security headers are present on /api/*. Only minor issue: duplicate security headers.
